==English==
{{wp}}

===Alternative forms===
* {{l|en|developement}} {{qualifier|obsolete}}

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|fr|développement}}, from {{der|en|fro|desvelopemens||unrolling}}. {{surf|en|develop|-ment}}. {{etydate|1756}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/dɪˈvɛl.əp.mənt/|a=RP,GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-development.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɖeʋᵊ.ləp.menʈ/|/ɖɪˈʋɛː.ləp.menʈ/|a=India}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The process of [[developing]]; [[growth]], [[directed]] [[change]].
#: {{syn|en|conversion|metamorphosis|transformation|Thesaurus:conversion}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''development''' of this story has been slow.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-07-19|author=[http://www.theguardian.com/profile/iansample Ian Sample]
|volume=189|issue=6|page=34|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/2013/jul/08/irregular-bedtimes-affect-childrens-brains Irregular bedtimes may affect children's brains]
|passage=Irregular bedtimes may disrupt healthy brain '''development''' in young children, according to a study of intelligence and sleeping habits.  ¶ Going to bed at a different time each night affected girls more than boys, but both fared worse on mental tasks than children who had a set bedtime, researchers found.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable|biology}} The process by which a mature [[multicellular]] [[organism]] or part of an organism is produced by the addition of new cells.
#: {{ux|en|The organism has reached a crucial stage in its '''development'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Schuster Hepaticae|volume=V|page=5|text=Of more significance in the nature of branch '''development'''; in the Jubulaceae, as in the Porellaceae, branches are acroscopic and normally replace a ventral leaf lobe.}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} Something which has [[develop]]ed.
#: {{ux|en|Our news team brings you the latest '''developments'''.}}
#: {{ux|en|up-to-date with new '''development'''s in [[IT]]}}
# {{lb|en|real estate|countable}} A project consisting of one or more commercial or residential buildings.
# {{lb|en|real estate|uncountable}} The building of such a project.
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The application of new ideas to practical problems (''cf.'' [[research]]).
#: {{ux|en|Our '''development''' department has produced three new adhesives this year.}}
# {{lb|en|chess|uncountable}} The active placement of the pieces, or the process of achieving it.
#: {{ux|en|White's '''development''' is good, but black's has been hampered by the pawn on e5.}}
# {{lb|en|music}} The process by in which previous material is transformed and restated.
# {{senseid|en|sonata}} {{lb|en|music}} The second section of a piece of music in [[sonata form]], in which the original theme is revisited in altered and varying form.
# {{lb|en|math}} The expression of a [[function]] in the form of a [[series]].
# {{lb|en|photography}} The processing of photographic film so as to bring out the images latent in it.
#: {{ux|en|I sent the film to a specialist lab for '''development'''.}}
